messages:
nicole-sales: Blackstone team kickoff  they need a short connectivity plan: PCI tokens must go through their on-prem DLP proxy; non-sensitive calls can use Redwood hosted. They want options + a one-paragraph CISO responsibilities note by COB.

rahul-solutions: Options: (A) VPC peering/TGW -> route sensitive subnets to customer's egress (can preserve src IP with passthrough). (B) Interface PrivateLink -> simpler surface, but usually SNATs source IP. (C) Model-routing to a private deployment with customer egress. Tradeoffs: complexity vs src-ip preservation and SNI visibility.

emma-netops: Their requirements: no broad 0.0.0.0/0 egress, SNI visible for TLS-inspect, and audit-friendly client IDs in logs. If they need original src-ip, they must deploy an NLB with proxy-protocol v2 or accept peering with proper route tables.

jules-security: For POC we recommend TLS passthrough. MITM inspection requires customer-supplied certs and an approved data-handling plan; that will need security review.

rahul-solutions: Minimal allowlist snippet for handoff (replace sample CIDRs):
``
- Dest: 18.205.0.0/16  # sample redwood edge range (we'll provide exact list)
- Ports: 443/TCP
- SNI: allow *.redwood.ai
- DNS: restrict to customer resolver or use PrivateLink DNS
``

emma-netops: PrivateLink billing is AWS/customer. Redwood charges onboarding for private deployments; proxied traffic may require a temporary Dedicated burst if throughput is high.

ops-bot: perf-note: adding proxy hop typically adds ~10-70ms. If >100 concurrent streams, recommend Dedicated burst.

jules-security: CISO paragraph: "Routing regulated inference through customer-controlled network devices keeps DLP and inspection inside your security boundary. The customer is responsible for certificate management, DLP configuration, firewall allowlists, and retention of audit identifiers. Redwood provides the private endpoint and assists during the POC to validate connectivity and performance. Any TLS interception (MITM) increases compliance obligations and requires mutual security sign-off."

nicole-sales: POC checklist: customer to provide exact CIDRs and SNI, decide on src-ip preservation (provision NLB if required), indicate TLS passthrough vs MITM, Redwood to provision staging PrivateLink or peering and run a short perf/latency test. I'll send this to Blackstone tomorrow. :thumbsup:
